description: Synthetic. Siblings planning a birthday; several shifts (A, AC, CP, rebellion, self-disclosure, NP, FC). Tests shift detection and quoting a feeling the speaker named.

messages.text: Mum's birthday is Sunday. Did you book the restaurant like you said?
Oh no. I completely forgot. I'm so sorry!!
Typical. You never follow through on anything.
That's not fair. I organised the last three family things.
Okay, fair. I'm just stressed, work has been a lot.
That sounds rough. Want me to call a few places tonight and send you options?
Yes please, that would help a lot 🙏
Haha deal. Let's make it the best birthday ever!

expected.notes: Our hypotheses only. A reading outside 'plausible' is a prompt to look closer, not an error.
